stem: "You might see a few curious Danes around, but that is because ……. used to be Danish outpost. This quaint town with its fort and a beautiful Church, the New Jerusalem, empty streets and deserted beach front is a quaint gem” The place referred to in this quotation lies on the –
expl: "Tharangambadi" a town on the coast of Tamil Nadu, was a colony of Denmark from 1620 to 1845. New Jerusalem Church and Zion Church are among the important buildings built by the Danish people. They left this place in 1845 after selling it to the British.

stem: Consider the map given below : The divisions along India's coastal region indicate?

options.label: c
options.text: The areas up to which sovereignty extends

expl: The divisions along India's coastline indicate underwater coastal relief contours. These show the depth of the sea floor. On this basis, there are four relief zones in the sea region – continental coast, continental slope, deep sea plains and ocean trenches/deeps.

stem: The northern part of the western Coastal Plain of India is also known as :
expl: The western coastal plain of India is hybridized, its northern part is called the Konkan Coast and the southern part is called the Malabar Coast, while the northern part of the eastern coastal plain is called the Northern Circars Coast and the southern part is called the Coromandel Coast.

stem: Which one of the following is the best example of repeated falls in sea level, giving rise to present-day extensive marshland?
expl: The Runn of Kutch is a Salt Marshy land. It is located in the Thar desert in the Kachchh district of Western Gujarat, India and Sindh Province of Pakistan. This area was a once a sprawling shallow of the Arabian sea until a constant geological shift closed off the connection with the sea. Over the years, the region gradually became a seasonal marshy salt desert. The present day shoreline and the sand dune deposition of Kutch's is the result of hundreds of years of rainless years around 5,000 years ago.
